hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook implementing a bonding curve as a Uniswap v4 position. Takes trading fees (1% base + optional creator tax up to 10%) as return deltas in the quote asset; applies a 99% snipe tax in the first 3 seconds post-launch unless the signer is exempt. The factory exclusively manages liquidity; when the curve sells out, the pool graduates to locked full-range liquidity in the same swap.
